name: Miro
description: Miro is a collaborative online whiteboard enabling teams to brainstorm ideas, design wireframes, plan workflows, and manage projects visually

tools.name: Attach Tag To Item
tools.description: Tool to attach an existing tag to a specific item on a Miro board. Use when you need to associate a tag with an item after confirming the board, item, and tag IDs. Note that card and sticky note items can have up to 8 tags.

inputs.name: tag_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the tag to attach to the item.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the item to attach the tag to. Card and sticky note items can have up to 8 tags.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the item.

tools.name: Copy Board
tools.description: Create a copy of an existing Miro board, optionally changing its name, description, policies, or destination team. Returns the new board, leaving the source board unchanged.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new board. Omit to use Miro's default (Untitled).

inputs.name: policy
inputs.about: Permissions and sharing policies for the new board.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: ID of the team where the copied board must be placed.

inputs.name: copy_from
inputs.about: ID of the existing board to copy.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the new board.

tools.name: Create App Card Item
tools.description: Creates an app card on a Miro board, with optional custom preview fields. The returned card ID is at the top level of the response.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Payload data for the app card

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for an app card item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent frame reference for nesting an app card item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: ID of the board to add the app card to

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for an app card item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for an app card item.

tools.name: Create Board
tools.description: Tool to create a new board. Use when you need to set up a board with a specific name, description, and policies. Example: "Create a new board named Project Plan". If workspace board quota is reached, returns HTTP 400; use MIRO_GET_BOARDS to reuse an existing board instead.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the board, length between 1 and 60 characters.

inputs.name: policy
inputs.about: Defines permissions and sharing policies for the board. Accepts specific enum values only; invalid values return HTTP 400 with error code 2.0703. Valid `sharingPolicy` values include `private`, `view`, `comment`, `edit`, `team_access`.

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the team where the board will be created.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the project (space) to which the board belongs.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the board, length between 0 and 300 characters.

tools.name: Create Card Item
tools.description: Tool to create a card item on a Miro board. Use when you need to add task cards with titles, descriptions, due dates, and assignees.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Core data for a card item.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for a card item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent item reference for nesting a card.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board where the card will be created

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for a card item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for a card item.

tools.name: Create Connector
tools.description: Tool to create a connector (edge/arrow) that links two existing board items. Use after creating or locating the two endpoint items (shapes/cards/stickies) to establish visual relationships in flowcharts and diagrams. Both start and end items must be specified; connectors cannot be created with loose endpoints.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.about: Shape/style of the connector line.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Visual styling properties for the connector line and caption.

inputs.name: endItem
inputs.about: Defines the ending point of the connector. Must specify either snapTo or position.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board where the connector will be created.

inputs.name: captions
inputs.about: Array of caption objects to display text along the connector.

inputs.name: startItem
inputs.about: Defines the starting point of the connector. Must specify either snapTo or position.

tools.name: Create Doc Format Item
tools.description: Create a structured Markdown doc on a Miro board.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent frame for the doc.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Markdown content for the doc.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board where the doc will be created.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Position for the doc on the board.

inputs.name: content_version
inputs.about: Optional numeric content version. Miro's live API rejects the documented string type.

tools.name: Create Document Item
tools.description: Tool to create a document item on a Miro board by providing a URL to the document. Use when you need to attach a document (PDF, DOC, etc.) to a board from a publicly accessible URL.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains the document URL and optional title.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent element reference for hierarchical positioning.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the board where the document will be created.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometric properties with fixed aspect ratio for the document item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Positioning information for the document item on the board.

tools.name: Create Document Item Using File From Device
tools.description: Create a document item on a Miro board by uploading a document file, with optional title, position, geometry, and parent frame.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Data containing document metadata like title.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent frame information for the item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical information about the item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Position information for the document item on the board.

inputs.name: resource
inputs.about: Document file to upload. Maximum file size: 6 MB. Supported format: PDF.

tools.name: Create Embed Item
tools.description: Tool to create an embed item on a Miro board by providing a URL to embed content (YouTube videos, websites, etc.). Use when you need to add embedded content from external sources to a board.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains information about the embed URL.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent element reference for hierarchical positioning.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical information about the embed item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Positioning information for the embed item on the board.

tools.name: Create Frame Item
tools.description: Tool to add a frame item to a Miro board. Use frames to group and organize diagram regions (e.g., swimlanes, sections, slides).

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains frame-specific properties like title and format. This field is required.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for a frame item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent item reference for nesting a frame.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board where the frame will be added

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for a frame item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for a frame item.

tools.name: Create Frame (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MIRO_CREATE_FRAME_ITEM instead. Tool to create a frame on a Miro board. Use when you need to group and organize content into sections or containers.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains frame item data, such as the title, frame type, or frame format.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for a frame item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create a frame.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for a frame item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for a frame item.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Tool to create a group on a Miro board by grouping multiple items together. Use when you need to organize related board items (shapes, sticky notes, cards, etc.) into a single logical group.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains the data with item IDs to be grouped.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where the group will be created.

tools.name: Create Image Item from URL
tools.description: Creates an image item on a Miro board by providing a URL to a publicly accessible image. This action adds images from external URLs rather than uploading files from local storage. Use this action when you have an image hosted online (e.g., on a CDN, image hosting service, or public URL) and want to add it to a Miro board without downloading and re-uploading the file.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains the image URL and optional title.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent item reference for nesting an image.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the image item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for an image item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for an image item.

tools.name: Create Image Item Using Local File
tools.description: Tool to create an image item on a Miro board by uploading a local image file. Use when you need to add an image from the user's device to a board, rather than referencing an external URL.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Core data for an image item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent item reference for nesting an image.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the image item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for an image item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for an image item.

inputs.name: resource
inputs.about: Image file to upload. Supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, SVG, etc.

tools.name: Create Items in Bulk
tools.description: Tool to create multiple items on a Miro board in a single request. Use when you need to add 1-20 items (text, sticky notes, shapes, cards, frames, etc.) efficiently. Items are created atomically in one API call.

inputs.name: items
inputs.about: List of items to create. You can create 1 to 20 items per request.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board where items will be created.

tools.name: Create Mind Map Node (Experimental)
tools.description: Tool to create a mind map node on a Miro board. Use when building mind maps or organizing ideas visually in a hierarchical structure. This is an experimental endpoint.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Core mind map node data including the node view with content.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the mind map node.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometry for the mind map node.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Position for the mind map node on the board.

tools.name: Create Shape Item (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MIRO_MIRO_CREATE_SHAPE_ITEM2 instead. Tool to create a native Miro shape item (diagram node) on a board. Use when building diagrams, flowcharts, or architecture diagrams with shapes that can then be connected via MIRO_CREATE_CONNECTOR.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Core shape data including content text and shape type.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for a shape item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent item reference for nesting a shape.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board where the shape will be created.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for a shape item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for a shape item.

tools.name: Create Shape Item
tools.description: Tool to create a shape item on a Miro board. Use when you need to add shapes (basic or flowchart) to a board with specific styling and positioning.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Core data for a shape item.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for a shape item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent frame information for the shape item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical information about the shape item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Position information for the shape item.

tools.name: Create Sticky Note Item
tools.description: Tool to create a sticky note item on a Miro board. Use when you need to add a new sticky note with customizable content, color, shape, and position.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains sticky note item data, such as the content or shape of the sticky note.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Contains information about the style of a sticky note item, such as the fill color or text alignment.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Contains information about the parent frame for the item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Contains geometrical information about the item. You can set either the width or height. You cannot set both the width and height at the same time.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Contains information about the item's position on the board, such as its x coordinate, y coordinate, and the origin of the x and y coordinates.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag on a Miro board. Use when you need to add a new tag with a specific title and color to categorize board items.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Text of the tag. Case-sensitive. Must be unique within the board.

inputs.name: boardId
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the tag.

inputs.name: fillColor
inputs.about: Fill color for the tag. Choose from predefined color options. Defaults to 'red' if not specified.

tools.name: Create Text Item
tools.description: Tool to create a text item on a Miro board. Use when you need to add text content to a board, such as labels, notes, or annotations.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Contains text item data, such as the content.

inputs.name: style
inputs.about: Styling options for a text item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: Parent item reference for nesting a text item.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the item.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.about: Geometrical dimensions for a text item.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: Board position for a text item.

tools.name: Delete App Card Item
tools.description: Tool to delete an app card item from a board. Use when you need to remove an app card item created by your app after it is no longer needed.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the app card item to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the app card item.

tools.name: Delete Board
tools.description: Delete a Miro board. On paid plans, deleted boards go to Trash and can be restored via the Miro UI within 90 days after deletion.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board to delete.

tools.name: Delete Card Item
tools.description: Tool to delete a card item from a board. Use when you need to remove a card item from a Miro board after it is no longer needed.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the item that you want to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the item.

tools.name: Delete Connector
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific connector from a board. Use when you need to remove a connector (edge/arrow) between board items after confirming its board and connector IDs.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the connector.

inputs.name: connector_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the connector that you want to delete.

tools.name: Delete Doc Format Item
tools.description: Delete a structured Miro doc format item from a board.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the doc format item to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the doc.

tools.name: Delete Document Item
tools.description: Tool to delete a document item from a board. Use when you need to remove a document item (e.g., PDF or image) that is no longer relevant. Example: "Delete the document item with ID 'item456' from board 'board123'."

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the document item to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the document item.

tools.name: Delete Embed Item
tools.description: Tool to delete an embed item from a board. Use when you need to remove an embedded content item (e.g., YouTube video, website) that is no longer needed.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the item that you want to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the item.

tools.name: Delete Frame Item
tools.description: Tool to delete a frame item from a Miro board. Use when you need to remove a frame that groups or organizes content on the board.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the frame that you want to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the frame.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a group from a board. Use when you need to remove a group and optionally its items.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the group.

inputs.name: delete_items
inputs.about: Indicates whether the items should be removed. Set to `true` to delete items in the group.

tools.name: Delete Image Item
tools.description: Tool to delete an image item from a board. Use when you need to remove an image that is no longer needed.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the item that you want to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the item.

tools.name: Delete Item
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific item from a board. Use when you need to remove an item (e.g., shape, sticky note) after confirming its board and item IDs.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the item to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the item.

inputs.name: item_id

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the mind map node.

inputs.name: item_id

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the item.

tools.description: Tool to delete a sticky note item from a board. Use when you need to remove a sticky note that is no longer needed.

inputs.name: item_id

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the item.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific tag from a board. Use when you need to remove a tag after confirming its board and tag IDs.

inputs.name: tag_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the tag that you want to delete.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to delete a specific tag.

tools.name: Delete Text Item
tools.description: Tool to delete a text item from a board. Use when you need to remove a text item after confirming its board and item IDs.

inputs.name: item_id

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to delete the item.

tools.name: Download Document Resource
tools.description: Retrieve signed URL metadata for a Miro document resource.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Board ID containing the document resource.

inputs.name: resource_id
inputs.about: Resource ID from documentUrl; this is not the document item ID.

tools.name: Download Image Resource
tools.description: Retrieve a Miro image resource as signed URL metadata or a downloaded file.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Image representation to retrieve.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Board ID containing the image resource.

inputs.name: redirect
inputs.about: When false, return short-lived signed URL metadata; when true, follow the provider redirect and return a downloadable file.

inputs.name: resource_id
inputs.about: Resource ID from the imageUrl returned by an image item action; this is not the image item ID.

tools.name: Get All Groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all groups on a Miro board with cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to list all groups and their associated items on a board.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The maximum number of groups to return at one time. Default is 10, minimum is 10, maximum is 50.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use the cursor value from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board.

tools.name: Get App Card Item 2
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific app card item by its ID from a Miro board. Use when you need to get the details of an existing app card item.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the item that you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to retrieve a specific item.

tools.name: Get Board (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MIRO_GET_SPECIFIC_BOARD instead. Tool to retrieve details of a specific board. Use when you have a board ID and need to fetch its metadata.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board to retrieve

tools.name: Get Board Items
tools.description: Tool to list items on a Miro board (shapes, stickies, cards, etc.) with pagination. Use when you need to page through board elements for analytics or reporting. Re-fetch before bulk updates to avoid stale item IDs.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Filter by item type. Note: 'connector' is not supported; use the separate Get Connectors action instead.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of items to return per page (10-50)

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor for paginating results; use the value from a prior response. Loop: pass the cursor from each response into the next call; stop when cursor is null (all items retrieved).

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board to retrieve items from

tools.name: Get Board Members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of members for a board. Use when you need to list all users with access to a board after confirming its ID. Results are scoped to the authenticated user's permissions; members or boards inaccessible to that user will not appear in the response.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of results per page (max 50).

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination, used to retrieve subsequent pages.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board.

tools.name: Get Boards (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MIRO_MIRO_GET_BOARDS2 instead. Tool to retrieve accessible boards with optional filters. Use when you need to list or search boards by team, project, owner, or keywords. Only boards accessible to the authenticated user are returned.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order of the results.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of boards to return per page (1-50). Values above 50 cause a 400 error.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Filter boards by owner user ID.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Search query to filter boards by name.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.about: Offset for pagination. Increment by `limit` value until results are exhausted to retrieve all pages.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Filter boards by team ID.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: Filter boards by project (space) ID.

tools.name: Get Boards V2
tools.description: Tool to retrieve accessible boards with optional filters. Use when you need to list or search boards by team, project, owner, or keywords with full pagination support.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order in which you want to view the result set. Options `last_created` and `alphabetically` are applicable only when you search for boards by team. Values: `default`, `last_modified`, `last_opened`, `last_created`, `alphabetically`. Default: `default` (If `team_id` is present, `last_created`. O

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of boards to retrieve (1-50). Default: 20

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Retrieves a list of boards that belong to a specific owner ID. You must pass the owner ID (for example, 3074457353169356300), not the owner name. You can use the 'owner' parameter with the `query` parameter to narrow down the board search results. Note that if you pass the `team_id` in the same requ

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Retrieves a list of boards that contain the query string provided in the board name or board description. You can use the `query` parameter with the owner parameter to narrow down the board search results.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.about: Zero-based offset of the first item in the collection. Default: 0

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The team_id for which you want to retrieve the list of boards. If this parameter is sent in the request, the `query` and `owner` parameters are ignored.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The `project_id` for which you want to retrieve the list of boards. If this parameter is sent in the request, the `query` and `owner` parameters are ignored.

tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific card item from a Miro board. Use when you need to fetch details of an existing card item by its ID.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the item that you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board from which you want to retrieve a specific item.

tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific group by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a group on a Miro board.

inputs.name: cursor

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board.

tools.name: Get Items Within Frame
tools.description: Get items within a specific frame on a Miro board. Retrieves child items contained within a frame by filtering with parent_item_id parameter. Use this action when you need to list all items (shapes, sticky notes, cards, etc.) that are nested inside a specific frame. This is useful for analyzing or processing frame contents.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Enum for board item types.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of items to return per page (minimum 1)

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor for paginating results; use the value from a prior response

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the frame

inputs.name: parent_item_id
inputs.about: ID of the frame (parent item) for which to retrieve child items

tools.name: Get oEmbed Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve oEmbed data for a Miro board. Use when you need to generate embeddable HTML code for a board or get board metadata in oEmbed format.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL pointing to the Miro board resource to return as oEmbed data. Must be a valid Miro board URL (e.g., https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVJ_fzYUs=).

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Specifies the return format of the response. Only 'json' is supported. Defaults to 'json' if not specified.

inputs.name: maxwidth
inputs.about: The maximum width available to the embed, in pixels. The oEmbed response will respect this constraint.

inputs.name: referrer
inputs.about: The URL pointing to the source of the request. Used to track where the embed will be displayed.

inputs.name: maxheight
inputs.about: The maximum height available to the embed, in pixels. The oEmbed response will respect this constraint.

tools.name: Get Organization Context
tools.description: Retrieves the organization associated with the current access token. Note: Miro's API does not have an endpoint to list all organizations a user has access to. This action uses the /v1/oauth-token endpoint to return the single organization context associated with the authenticated token, along with team and user information. For Enterprise users who need to work with organizations, use organization-specific endpoints like MIRO_GET_ORGANIZATION_MEMBERS which require an org_id parameter.

tools.name: Remove Board Member

inputs.name: board_member_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board member to remove.

tools.name: Remove Tag From Item

inputs.about: Unique identifier of the tag to remove from the item.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the item to remove the tag from.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the board containing the item.

tools.name: Share Board
tools.description: Tool to share a board by inviting users via email. Use when you need to grant access to a board by sending email invitations to new members. You can invite up to 20 users per call and assign them roles (viewer, commenter, editor, coowner, or owner).

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Role of the board members being invited. Options: viewer (view only), commenter (view and comment), editor (view, comment, and edit), coowner (full access except changing owner), or owner (full access including changing owner). Note: Inviting users with role 'owner' has the same effect as 'coowner'.

inputs.name: emails
inputs.about: Email addresses of the users you want to invite to the board. You can invite up to 20 members per call.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: Optional message that will be sent in the invitation email to the invited users.

inputs.name: board_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (ID) of the board to which you want to invite members.
